title: Grade the LIVE regime vetoes on money: replay every regime_hard_gate (enforced) dropped intent on its own candles (entry/SL/TP as emitted, desk_outcomes.replay, net of cost) vs matched-random drops; the ml-btc-router-cells orphan's next iteration
note: WHY (2026-11-25 ML-PRIMARY): ml_model ml-btc-router-cells is an ORPHAN (iteration_orphans.py). The trend_vol cells HARD-veto entries (config/regime_policy.yaml trend_vol: trend_donchian long, ict_scalp_5m both, squeeze_breakout_4h short). The only money test, RQ-20261112-bcd2-01 (dropped TD trades vs same-count random drops), FAILED, but on TRAINER-REPLAYED vol labels that do not reproduce the live gate (RQ-20261117-aadc-01 FAIL: BTC kappa 0.24, SOL 0.51); the serve-path diff (PI-20261118-ZZUFKM1F-0001, rows ML-VOL-LABEL-LIVE-VERIFY / DRIFT-REMEDIATE-btc-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2) is unowned. This build sidesteps label parity: it grades exactly what the live gate dropped. BUILD: (1) read regime_hard_gate rows with enforced=true from the trader journal/audit (live_replay_parity.py already reads them) for the window since the gate went live; (2) for each dropped intent take symbol, side, timeframe, entry/SL/TP as emitted; (3) replay with scripts/ops/desk_outcomes.replay on the leg's own candles, net of the full cost stack; (4) compare the dropped set's mean net R with N matched-random drops of non-vetoed intents of the same leg x month. Then a pre-registered unit: PASS (dropped trades lose more than random, CI) keeps the cells; FAIL -> Tier-3 proposal to remove the cell(s) per leg (regime-selectivity no-cosmetic-cell rule). Done when the unit is graded. 2026-11-26 built: held PR #28982 (scripts/research/regime_veto_counterfactual.py + unit RQ-20261126-c4f2-01 + snapshot comms/live_parity/regime_veto_20261126/). MEASURED COUNTS (pre-outcome), live 2026-09-01..11-26: 247 unique signals of the gated strategies; 38 dropped on every tick = 37 ADX-trend (htf_pullback_trend_2h 30, fvg_range_15m 7) + 1 ML-vol (squeeze_breakout_4h); 158 mixed (label flipped within the bar; 11 ML-vol). So the ML vol router PREVENTED ~1 trade in 3 months: its money effect is bounded near zero. Deciding axis re-designated to trend before any outcome (n 37, MDE ~0.55 R). Gap: ict_scalp_5m emits no _eval rows, so its 8 drop rows are unjoinable. Next: grade runs after merge. 2026-11-26 #28982 MERGED (head 6612fb0d97). landed_unproven until RQ-20261126-c4f2-01 dispatches and lands research/results/RQ-20261126-c4f2-01/ (observation that closes it); the manager holds any Tier-3 cell removal until that grade. 2026-11-26 RQ-20261126-c4f2-01 run 45745911700: the GRADE RAN (comms/research/RQ-20261126-c4f2-01/45745911700/grade.json on main) but the record landed producer_failed because my verdict.json lacked 'n' (fix + re-arm: held PR #29022). MEASURED result under the registered rule (deciding axis = trend, re-designated pre-outcome): FAIL, 'veto_cost_money'. 29 ADX-trend-axis signals dropped on every tick replayed at mean +0.70 R (CI90 +0.22..+1.17), -20.3 R forgone; matched random same-strategy signals +0.14 R; dropped beat 96% of random draws. By strategy: htf_pullback_trend_2h n 22 mean +1.08 R (the veto COST money); fvg_range_15m n 7 mean -0.50 R (the veto SAVED money). ML-vol axis n 1 (+2.83 R), underpowered. Population: 247 live signals, 198 replayed (GLD 37 not on Binance, 12 horizon not elapsed); bracket replay (emitted SL/TP, 48-bar horizon), NOT the strategies' own management; n small. Registered fail_action: propose to the manager the data-backed Tier-3 removal of the ADX cells on the legs where the drops cost money (htf_pullback_trend_2h), keep fvg_range_15m's. 2026-11-26 05:47Z: c4f2-01 PROPER RECORD landed (run 45756678009, after the #29022 verdict.json fix + re-arm): FAIL, read_state measured, n 198 replayed of 247 live dropped signals (could_not_replay: GLD no bars 37, horizon not elapsed 12). TREND (ADX) axis: veto_cost_money, n 29 dropped, mean +0.70 R (CI90 +0.22..+1.17) vs matched control +0.14 R, sum avoided -20.3 R; htf_pullback_trend_2h n22 +1.08 R, fvg_range_15m n7 -0.50 R. ML-vol axis underpowered (n 1). Follow-up: walk-forward confirmation 4d1c-01 for htf_pullback_trend_2h cells (merged #29024, queued) before any Tier-3 cell change; fvg_range_15m's cells stay (they saved money). 2026-11-26 06:20Z ML-PRIMARY: 4d1c-01 (run 45763510846) = FAIL, measured, htf_pullback_trend_2h own harness (backtest_pullback, declared params incl. tp_r 50), 454 trades 2020-09..2026-10, full cost stack. Removing all five ADX off-cells: delta -0.0257 R/available trade, t -0.45, random share 0.535, years positive 2/5 (2024, 2025). Per-cell (reported only): off-cells n 330 mean -0.028 R; the one on-cell (transitional/long) n 27 mean +0.063. Registered fail_action applies: the cells STAY (c4f2-01's live +1.08 at n 22 was a window effect on the bracket replay). No Tier-3 diff. Separately, b71e-01 rates hand rule (RULE-REGIME-RATES-SHOCK-20261126, run 45756680656) = FAIL, 7/7 non-crypto legs measured, 1,063 trades: skip long entries after a DFII10 +20 bp/20-obs shock gives delta -0.016 R, t -0.60, random share 0.26, years positive 2/5. Caveat: iaum_pullback_1d is proxied to GLD's Dukascopy feed with identical params, so it duplicates gld_pullback_1d (identical CSV, n 47, net 21.04); dropping the duplicate leaves the verdict unchanged (both read -0.27).
